hook: Sitting all day is killing your health silently
caption:
Rožantha kurchike kurchuni panichesthunnara? Idi mee aarogyam meeda chala pedda prabhavam chupisthundi. Ekkkuvasepu kurchovadam valla raktha prasrana taggipoyi, fat accumulate avuthundi. Idi heart issues ki, diabetes ki daritiyocchu. Diniki ekaika pariskaram - prati 30 minutes ki oka sari levadam, chinnaga nadavadam! ee reel ni me friends and family tho share chesi, vallani kuda alert cheyyandi! 

#SedentaryLifestyle #HealthTipsTelugu #FitnessGoals #ActiveLiving #HeartHealth #WellnessTelugu #HealthyHabits #FitnessTelugu
poster_caption:
Did you know that prolonged sitting acts like a brake on your entire metabolic engine? 🛑

When we sit for hours on end, our biology shifts into a low-power state:
• Lipase production drops by 90%, halting fat burning
• Insulin sensitivity plummets, spiking blood sugar
• Lower limb blood flow decreases, stressing your cardiovascular system

The good news? You can easily reverse these effects with micro-movements throughout your day.

📌 Save this guide for your daily health routine!
